services.desc: To request private lessons, click the link at the bottom of this page and complete the interest form, noting any preferred dates and times that work best with your schedule in addition to information about your swimmer. - Small group lessons (2-4 swimmers) can also be arranged for siblings or ​friends if interested and an instructor is available. Instructors will then be paired with swimmers on a first come, first served basis, and connected to you via email to create a schedule based off you and your instructor's availability. PLEASE NOTE- completing the interest form does not guarantee lessons or a lessons instructor, as the number of instructors available and their respective schedules
